plan.notes: Source: official SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, University Studies Programs section (catalog pp. 261-270; PDF text lines ~17854-17919), 'Associate of Arts (AA) in University Studies - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog'. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed option's code. Credit ranges: none present. CREDIT ANOMALY (kept verbatim): Fall Semester 3 'World Literature I/II or Philosophy (ENGL 2213, ENGL 2223, or PHIL 2403)' is printed as 4 credits even though the listed options are 3-credit courses; the semester total (16) and program total (60) reconcile only with the printed 4. Elective placeholders coded ELECTIVE, choice=true. Category mapping: core = general-education courses/choices; major = GSTD 1002 university requirement; elective = unrestricted elective slots. No per-course prerequisites are stated in the plan table; external_prereqs is empty.
